details: ASTROGUARD SENTINEL is an AI-powered health monitoring system designed to protect astronauts during space missions. It analyzes health data, monitors physical and mental well-being, identifies unusual patterns, and generates early warnings about potential health risks. The project consists of two main dashboards: an astronaut dashboard providing personal health updates and alerts, and an Earth-based dashboard allowing medical specialists to examine detailed health trends, review alerts, and make informed decisions through human intervention. A key feature is its ability to maintain onboard monitoring during communication delays or interruptions, synchronizing collected data with Earth once connectivity is restored. Our solution combines artificial intelligence with medical expertise to improve early risk detection, reduce response delays, and support astronaut safety. Its creativity lies in connecting real-time monitoring, predictive AI analysis, and human decision-making within one integrated system. The project aims to contribute to safer long-duration missions and the future of human space exploration.
